East of Ziz, the Venture Company is clear-cutting Windshear Crag; one of the Operators carries the blueprints. Piznik mines in the small mine on the east side: stay with him while he mines, Venture Co. thugs come for him. Careful: The kobolds arrive in waves. The first wave is melee fighters, and the second adds casters to the mix. Regular mobs in the mine respawn quickly and can join the fight while the waves are coming. A group is recommended.
Récupérez 1 × Plan du Super-Découpeur 6000 sur Opérateur de la KapitalRisk
